answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may trade, with the stake sized to the value it moves. Reputation then accrues slowly from verified work, like water carving a canyon: one flood of fake identities cannot fake a long history of useful service. If an agent misbehaves, its stake is slashed and its reputation drains away, so the tide of cheap copies turns against the attacker instead of rewarding them.
